up: Retrieve the first 200 metabolism records associated with the enzyme CYP2B6. For each record, include the canonical SMILES of the substrate, the substrate compound name, the name of the parent compound, the metabolic conversion description, the pathway key, and the organism name. Order the results by the metabolism ID.
sql: WITH cyp2b6_targets AS (SELECT tid FROM target_dictionary WHERE pref_name = 'CYP2B6'), substrate_info AS (SELECT m.met_id, m.drug_record_id, m.substrate_record_id, m.met_conversion, m.pathway_key, m.organism, cs_sub.canonical_smiles, md_sub.pref_name AS substrate_name, md_par.pref_name AS parent_name FROM metabolism m LEFT JOIN target_dictionary td ON m.enzyme_tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN compound_records cr_sub ON m.substrate_record_id = cr_sub.record_id LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs_sub ON cr_sub.molregno = cs_sub.molregno LEFT JOIN molecule_dictionary md_sub ON cr_sub.molregno = md_sub.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_records cr_par ON m.drug_record_id = cr_par.record_id LEFT JOIN molecule_dictionary md_par ON cr_par.molregno = md_par.molregno, cyp2b6_targets t WHERE m.enzyme_tid = t.tid) SELECT s.canonical_smiles, s.substrate_name, s.parent_name, s.met_conversion, s.pathway_key, s.organism FROM substrate_info s ORDER BY s.met_id LIMIT 200
